name: Laoshan Beer
verdict: Laoshan Beer is the national second brand of Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd., whose controlling shareholder Tsingtao Brewery Group (32.51%) is solely owned by the Qingdao municipal SASAC; continuing sleeve sponsor of Qingdao Hainiu.

why.text: Laoshan Beer is a brand of Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd., whose controlling shareholder is Tsingtao Brewery Group (32.51%); the Qingdao municipal state-assets commission is that group's sole shareholder and the company's ultimate controller. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that China committed serious human rights violations against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind Laoshan Beer is the Chinese state's.
